candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to return true only for IERC165 (removes IAccessControl support), which alters observable return when queried for IAccessControl interface id.
Change hasRole to invert the stored boolean, returning !members[account] instead of members[account].
Change hasRole to always return true regardless of stored membership.
Change hasRole to always return false regardless of stored membership.
Change hasRole to return membership of the zero address instead of the queried account.
Change hasRole to check membership under a fixed role (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) instead of the provided role.
